verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents an official Editor MCP server that lets AI assistants connect to an open Editor session, modify project data, and verify changes via the viewport/running app, alongside a full Editor API for programmatic scene manipulation, asset management, and custom tool integration, plus PlayCanvas Skills giving AI agents PlayCanvas-specific workflows and a REST API. This directly matches the story's ask for an agent-drivable, documented scriptable interface covering scene/node creation, property edits, and build-related automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the MCP server or Editor API reliably drives full build triggers, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (404s on candidate paths), leaving some automation surface undocumented in a structured format.
